sg-001.morning: “You are up early. Sit, the porridge is hot, and I would rather hear your counsel before the others arrive.”
sg-001.afternoon: “Come in out of the sun. I am told you read people well. Tell me what you see in the faces outside.”
sg-001.evening: “The lamp burns low and I cannot sleep. Walk with me, and tell me whether I have been too gentle.”

sg-002.morning: “The council begins soon. Tell me quickly: which of my officers will speak the truth today?”
sg-002.afternoon: “I do not keep idle advisers. You have until the inspection ends to prove you are not one.”
sg-002.evening: “Wine, or silence? Either way, say what you would burn to keep the realm whole.”

sg-003.morning: “The pass opens at first light. Ride behind me, and do not speak unless you must.”
sg-003.afternoon: “The heat is heavy and the road is long. You may ask your question while the horses rest.”
sg-003.evening: “The fire is low. Sit. I will answer one question, and only if it is honest.”

sg-004.morning: “The mist is thin today. You came a long way to knock on a hermit's door. State your business plainly.”
sg-004.afternoon: “Tea is ready. The map on the wall is unfinished, and I suspect you can see where.”
sg-004.evening: “The stars are clear tonight. Tell me what you hope to read in them, and I shall tell you what I see.”

sg-005.morning: “The drill has begun. Tell me, how many ships on this river would you trust with your life?”
sg-005.afternoon: “You brought the river charts? Good. Show me the bend that worries you.”
sg-005.evening: “A song before the battle, perhaps? Sit. The water is quiet, and so am I, for now.”

sg-006.morning: “You ride behind me? Brave. Keep up, or be left. The red horse does not wait.”
sg-006.afternoon: “Everyone wants me for their banner. Tell me why I should want yours.”
sg-006.evening: “The tent is empty tonight. Say what you came to say before I change my mind.”

sg-007.morning: “Walk slowly. In this corridor even the silence has listeners. What do you wish to ask me?”
sg-007.afternoon: “The garden is empty, for once. Speak softly, and I will answer as plainly as I can.”
sg-007.evening: “The lanterns are lit. Stay if you wish. Few people ask me what I want.”

sg-008.morning: “The road behind us is quiet, but I do not trust it. Check the child's cloak before we ride.”
sg-008.afternoon: “Stay low. The line will break at the third banner. Tell me when you are ready.”
sg-008.evening: “Dusk is the hour I like least. Stay close, and tell me what you saw on the ridge.”
